name: Aberrant Sorcery
description: Psionic power from the Far Realm or Astral Plane: telepathy, mind-bending spells and bodily mutation.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.text: Always-prepared psionic spells, gained at the Sorcerer levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.text: Bonus Action: link minds with a creature within 30 ft. You can talk telepathically at a range of Charisma modifier miles (min 1) for a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.text: Cast any level 1+ spell from your Psionic Spells by paying Sorcery Points equal to its level instead of a slot. Doing so removes the Verbal, Somatic and non-costly Material components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.text: Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.text: Bonus Action, 1+ Sorcery Points: for 10 minutes gain one benefit per point spent from Swim 2x Speed and water breathing, Fly Speed equal to Speed with hover, seeing Invisible creatures within 60 ft, or squeezing through 1-inch gaps and slipping restraints.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.text: Magic action: teleport up to 120 ft. Creatures within 30 ft of where you left make a Strength save or take 3d10 Force damage and get pulled toward that spot (half on a save). Once per Long Rest, or spend 5 Sorcery Points to use it again.

name: Clockwork Sorcery
description: Magic of cosmic order from Mechanus: balancing luck, warding allies and bringing chaos to heel.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.text: Always-prepared order-themed spells, gained at the Sorcerer levels shown in the spell list. You also choose or roll a cosmetic Manifestation of Order whenever you cast Sorcerer spells.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.text: Reaction: when a creature you see within 60 ft is about to roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage, cancel that Advantage/Disadvantage. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.text: Magic action: spend 1-5 Sorcery Points to ward yourself or a creature within 30 ft with that many d8s. The ward can spend dice to reduce damage taken by the roll. Lasts until a Long Rest or until you use this again.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.text: Bonus Action: for 1 minute, attacks against you can't have Advantage and you treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on D20 Tests. Once per Long Rest, or spend 5 Sorcery Points to use it again.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.text: Magic action: spirits in a 30-ft Cube heal up to 100 HP split among creatures you choose, repair damaged objects and end spells of level 6 or lower you choose. Once per Long Rest, or spend 7 Sorcery Points to use it again.

name: Shadow Sorcery
description: Magic from the Shadowfell: darkvision, death-defying resilience, shadow beasts and shadow-stepping.

features.name: Shadow Spells
features.text: Always-prepared shadow and darkness spells, gained at the Sorcerer levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Power of Shadow
features.text: Eyes of the Dark: Darkvision 120 ft, Blindsight 10 ft, and you see normally through Darkness from your own spells. Strength of the Grave: when dropped to 0 HP (not killed outright), make a Charisma save (DC 5 + damage) to instead drop to Charisma mod + Sorcerer level HP; once per Long Rest.

features.name: Beasts of Ill Omen
features.text: Spend 3 Sorcery Points to cast Summon Beast as a Bonus Action with no slot, preparation or Material components. The beast is shadowy, enemies near it have Disadvantage on saves against your spells, and you can make the spell non-Concentration (1 minute).

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.text: Bonus Action: while in Dim Light or Darkness, teleport up to 120 ft to an unoccupied space you see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.text: While Innate Sorcery is active you can take shadow form: move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end a turn inside one) and gain Resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant. Once per Long Rest, or spend 6 Sorcery Points to use it again.

name: Spellfire Sorcery
description: Radiant spellfire from the Weave itself: healing bursts, searing flames and absorbing enemy spells.

features.name: Spellfire Burst
features.text: Once per turn, when you spend 1+ Sorcery Points as part of a Magic action or Bonus Action, choose: Bolstering Flames (you or a creature within 30 ft gains 1d4 + Cha mod Temporary HP) or Radiant Fire (a creature within 30 ft takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant damage).

features.name: Spellfire Spells
features.text: Always-prepared healing and fire spells, gained at the Sorcerer levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Absorb Spells
features.text: You always have Counterspell prepared. When a target fails its save against your Counterspell, you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Honed Spellfire
features.text: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level to the Temporary HP, and Radiant Fire damage becomes 1d8.

features.name: Crown of Spellfire
features.text: When you use Innate Sorcery you can infuse it with spellfire: spend up to Cha mod Hit Point Dice to reduce an attack's damage once per turn, gain a 60 ft Fly Speed with hover, and take no damage on a successful save against half-damage effects (half on a fail). Once per Long Rest, or spend 5 Sorcery Points to use it again.

name: Wild Magic Sorcery
description: Chaotic magic that can surge unpredictably, with luck-twisting tricks to bend fate.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.text: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table. Spell effects from the table can't be changed by Metamagic.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.text: Give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test before rolling. You can't use it again until you cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot (which triggers an automatic Wild Magic Surge roll) or finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.text: Reaction, 1 Sorcery Point: after another visible creature rolls a d20 for a D20 Test, roll 1d4 and add or subtract it from that roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.text: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and use either result.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.text: After casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose any effect from the Wild Magic Surge table except the last row instead of rolling. Once per Long Rest.

name: Archfey Patron
description: A pact with a Feywild power, built on teleportation, charm and trickery.

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.text: Always-prepared fey spells, gained at the Warlock levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.text: Cast Misty Step free a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest. Each cast can add Refreshing Step (1d10 Temporary HP to you or a creature within 10 ft) or Taunting Step (creatures within 5 ft of where you left make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on attacks against others).

features.name: Misty Escape
features.text: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction when you take damage. Adds Disappearing Step (Invisible until your next turn or you attack, deal damage or cast) and Dreadful Step (2d10 Psychic damage to creatures within 5 ft of your start or end space on a failed Wisdom save).

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.text: Immune to Charmed. Reaction after being hit: halve the damage and force the attacker to make a Wisdom save or take Psychic damage equal to the damage you take. Once per Long Rest, or expend a Pact Magic slot to restore it.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.text: After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, cast Misty Step as part of that action without a slot.

name: Celestial Patron
description: A pact with a radiant being of the Upper Planes, granting healing, radiant power and protective light.

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.text: Always-prepared radiant and healing spells, gained at the Warlock levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Healing Light
features.text: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your Warlock level. Bonus Action: heal yourself or a creature within 60 ft by spending up to Cha mod dice (min 1). The pool refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.text: Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, add your Charisma modifier to the Radiant or Fire damage of a Warlock spell against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.text: After a Short or Long Rest or Magical Cunning, you gain Temporary HP equal to Warlock level + Cha mod, and up to five creatures you see gain half your level + Cha mod.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.text: When you or an ally within 60 ft is about to make a Death Saving Throw, the creature regains half its HP maximum and can stand up. Creatures within 30 ft of it take 2d8 + Cha mod Radiant damage and are Blinded until end of turn. Once per Long Rest.

name: Great Old One Patron
description: A pact with an alien Far Realm entity, giving telepathy, psychic magic and mind-shielding.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.text: Bonus Action: telepathically link with a creature within 30 ft for a number of minutes equal to your Warlock level, communicating at a range of Cha mod miles (min 1).

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.text: Always-prepared mind-warping spells, gained at the Warlock levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.text: Warlock spells that deal damage can be changed to Psychic damage, and your Enchantment and Illusion Warlock spells need no Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.text: When you link with Awakened Mind, the target makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it has Disadvantage on attacks against you and you have Advantage against it for the bond. Once per Short or Long Rest, or expend a Pact Magic slot to restore it.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.text: Hex is always prepared. When you cast it, the target also has Disadvantage on saving throws of the ability you chose.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.text: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it. Resistance to Psychic damage, and creatures that deal Psychic damage to you take the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.text: Summon Aberration can skip Concentration (1 minute) and the aberration gets Temporary HP equal to Warlock level + Cha mod. It also deals your Hex bonus damage as Psychic the first time each turn it hits a Hexed target.

name: Undead Patron
description: A pact with a lich, vampire or other undead power, offering a dreadful avatar form and necrotic resilience.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.text: Bonus Action: transform for 1 minute, gaining 1d10 + Warlock level Temporary HP, Immunity to Frightened, and once per turn on a hit a Wisdom save or the target is Frightened until end of your next turn. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Undead Spells
features.text: Always-prepared necromantic spells, gained at the Warlock levels shown in the spell list.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.text: Your Necrotic damage ignores Resistance, and once per turn you can change a damaged spell's type to Necrotic. In Form of Dread, you can roll one extra Necrotic damage die once per turn on a Necrotic hit. You also don't need sleep and ignore Exhaustion from thirst, hunger or suffocation.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.text: Resistance to Necrotic damage (Immunity in Form of Dread). When dropped to 0 HP, you can erupt: creatures in a 30-ft Emanation make a Constitution save or take 2d10 + Cha mod Necrotic (half on a save), then your HP becomes twice your Warlock level and you gain 1 Exhaustion. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Superior Dread
features.text: While in Form of Dread you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, a hovering Fly Speed equal to your Speed that lets you pass through creatures and objects, and your Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells skip non-costly components.

name: Vestige Patron
description: A pact with a dying god, manifested as a Vestige Companion that fights alongside you.

features.name: Vestige Companion
features.text: You gain a Small Celestial, Fiend or Undead companion (chosen each Long Rest) that acts on your turn, mostly Dodging unless you command it with a Bonus Action. AC 13 + Cha mod, HP 4 + 4x Warlock level, Vestige's Strike (1d6 + 3 + Cha mod Fire/Necrotic/Radiant, uses your spell attack), and a once-per-day Divine Power by type: Healing Touch, Fiendish Swap or Cursed Invocation. If it drops to 0 HP, a 1-minute ceremony brings it back.

features.name: Vestige Spells
features.text: Pick one Cleric domain (Life, Light, Trickery or War). Its domain spells become Warlock spells for you and are always prepared at the matching Warlock levels.

features.name: Vestige Power
features.text: Your companion regains Divine Power after a Short or Long Rest or when you use Magical Cunning. While within 30 ft of it, you share its damage Resistances.

features.name: Vestige Recovery
features.text: Reaction, expend a Pact Magic slot: when the companion would drop to 0 HP, set it to full HP and teleport it to a space you see within 30 ft of it. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Semblance of Life
features.text: Magic action: for 1 hour, shape-shift the companion (within 90 ft) into a Celestial, Fiendish or Undead Spirit of a spell level equal to half your Warlock level (max 9). It gains Temporary HP equal to the spirit's HP. Once per Long Rest.

name: Abjurer
description: Specialist in protective and banishing magic, with a damage-absorbing ward.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.text: Add two Abjuration-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Abjuration spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.text: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot creates a ward on you (once per Long Rest) with HP equal to twice your Wizard level + Int mod. It absorbs damage instead of you, and recovers 2x a slot's level when you cast Abjuration spells or spend a slot as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.text: Reaction: when a creature you see within 30 ft takes damage, your Arcane Ward absorbs it instead.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.text: Counterspell and Dispel Magic are always prepared. You can cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action, add your Proficiency Bonus to its check, and keep the slot if either spell fails to stop a spell.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.text: Advantage on saving throws against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

name: Bladesinger
description: A wizard who blends swordplay and magic, with a defensive Bladesong stance.

features.name: Bladesong
features.text: Bonus Action (no armor or Shield), 1 minute: add Int mod (min +1) to AC, +10 ft Speed, Advantage on Acrobatics, use Int mod for weapon attack and damage rolls, and add Int mod to Concentration saves. Uses equal to your Int modifier (min 1) per Long Rest; Arcane Recovery restores one use.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.text: Proficiency with Martial Melee weapons without Two-Handed or Heavy, use a proficient Melee weapon as a Spellcasting Focus, and one skill from Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one of those attacks can be replaced by a one-action Wizard cantrip.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.text: Reaction while Bladesong is active: expend a spell slot to reduce damage by 5 times the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.text: After casting an action spell, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

name: Conjurer
description: Specialist in teleportation and summoning, making summoned creatures tougher.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.text: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to a space you see, or swap places with a willing Medium or smaller creature. Uses equal to your Int modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.text: Add two Conjuration-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Conjuration spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Distant Transposition
features.text: Benign Transposition range becomes 60 ft, and you can restore a use by expending a level 3+ spell slot.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.text: Creatures you summon or create with a Conjuration spell slot gain Temporary HP equal to twice your Wizard level and Resistance to all damage except Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant while those HP last.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.text: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

features.name: Splintered Summons
features.text: When you cast a summon-spirit Conjuration spell with a slot, you can summon two creatures instead of one, each with half HP. Once per Long Rest, or expend a level 5+ slot to restore it.

name: Diviner
description: Specialist in foresight, using pre-rolled Portent dice to alter fate.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.text: Add two Divination-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Divination spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Portent
features.text: After a Long Rest, roll two d20s. You can replace a D20 Test by you or a creature you see with one of them (once per turn, before the roll). Unused rolls are lost on the next Long Rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.text: Casting a Divination spell with a level 2+ slot restores one expended slot of a lower level (max level 5).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.text: Bonus Action, once per Short or Long Rest: gain Darkvision 120 ft, the ability to read any language, or See Invisibility cast free, until your next rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.text: Portent now gives three d20s instead of two.

name: Enchanter
description: Specialist in charm and mind magic, with a hypnotic gaze and memory tampering.

features.name: Enchanting Conversationalist
features.text: Gain proficiency in Deception, Intimidation or Persuasion, and add your Int modifier (min +1) to checks with that skill.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.text: Add two Enchantment-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Enchantment spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Hypnotic Presence
features.text: Magic action: a creature within 10 ft that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed, Incapacitated and has Speed 0 for 1 minute (ends if it takes damage or moves away). Uses equal to your Int modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.text: When casting an Enchantment spell that scales to extra targets with a higher slot, raise its effective level by 1. Uses equal to your Int modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.text: Reaction: when a creature within 30 ft hits you, it makes a Wisdom save or the attack misses and redirects to another creature in range. Once per Long Rest, or restore it by casting an Enchantment spell with a slot.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.text: A creature Charmed by your Enchantment spell can stay unaware of it, and you can later force an Intelligence save to erase 1 + Int mod hours of its memory.

name: Illusionist
description: Specialist in illusions, with quieter casting, spectral summons and semi-real creations.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.text: Add two Illusion-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Illusion spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.text: Cast Illusion spells without Verbal components, and Illusion spells with range 10+ ft gain 60 ft range. You learn Minor Illusion (free, or another cantrip if known), and can create sound and image together as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.text: Summon Beast and Summon Fey are always prepared. You can cast either as an Illusion once without a slot per Long Rest (creature has half HP).

features.name: Illusory Self
features.text: Reaction: when hit by an attack, an illusory duplicate makes it miss automatically. Once per Short or Long Rest, or expend a level 2+ slot to restore it.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.text: After casting an Illusion spell with a slot, make one inanimate nonmagical part of it real for 1 minute as a Bonus Action; it can't deal damage or inflict conditions.

name: Necromancer
description: Specialist in death and undeath, with undead minions, necrotic resistance and ravaging explosions.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.text: Add two Necromancy-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Necromancy spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Necromancy Spellbook
features.text: Resistance to Necrotic damage. Find Familiar can take Skeleton or Zombie forms or an Undead type, and your familiar can attack by Reaction in place of one of your attacks. Casting a Necromancy spell with a slot heals an Undead you see within 60 ft for the slot's level + your Wizard level.

features.name: Grave Power
features.text: While holding your spellbook: Arcane Recovery reduces Exhaustion by 1, and your Wizard spells and features ignore Necrotic Resistance.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.text: Animate Dead is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot, at +1 effective level. While holding your spellbook, Undead you create gain bonus max HP equal to Int mod + half your Wizard level, and Undead you control deal extra Necrotic damage equal to your Int modifier (min 1) on hits within 60 ft.

features.name: Harvest Undead
features.text: Reaction when you become Bloodied but are not reduced to 0 HP: reduce a visible Undead you control to 0 HP and regain HP equal to your Wizard level.

features.name: Death's Master
features.text: While holding your spellbook: Bonus Action (once per Long Rest) to give your created or summoned Undead within 60 ft Temporary HP equal to your Wizard level; and Undead you see dropping to 0 HP can explode for Necrotic damage (d6s equal to half its unspent Hit Dice, Dexterity save for half) in a 10-ft Emanation, costing a level 5+ slot and a Reaction if you don't control it.

name: Transmuter
description: Specialist in transformation, with a Transmuter's Stone, Alter Self and Polymorph, and eventual reality-altering feats.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.text: Add two Transmutation-school Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and add one more free Transmutation spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.text: After a Long Rest, create a Tiny stone that works as a Spellcasting Focus. Its bearer gains Constitution save proficiency and one chosen benefit: Darkvision 60 ft, Resistance to Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison/Thunder, or +10 ft Speed. You can change the benefit when you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot.

features.name: Wondrous Alteration
features.text: Alter Self is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot. While it's active you get bonuses for each option: Aquatic Adaptation (Dash as a Bonus Action underwater), Change Appearance (Advantage on Deception), Natural Weapons (2d6 damage and Advantage on Concentration saves).

features.name: Empowered Transmutation
features.text: When you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot that has no attack roll or save, raise its effective level by 1. Uses equal to your Int modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Potent Stone
features.text: Your stone can have up to two benefits (Resistance can repeat with different types), and adds Mighty Build (Advantage on Strength saves, counts as one size larger for carrying) and Tremorsense 30 ft.

features.name: Shape-Shifter
features.text: Polymorph is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot. When you target yourself, you can keep your mind, proficiencies, class features and feats and cast Transmutation spells without costly or consumed components. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.text: Magic action, consuming your stone (a level 7+ slot saves it): transmute a nonmagical object up to 10 ft Cube (10 minutes handling), heal a creature for half its max HP and cure curses and conditions (Panacea), cast Raise Dead free, or make a willing creature 3d10 years younger and remove Exhaustion.
